top_signals.title: Amazon’s Ailing Stock Needs Booming Cloud Growth to Revive Rally
top_signals.summary: Blistering cloud growth sent Amazon.com Inc. shares soaring after its last earnings report. Now with more than half those gains gone, the firm needs to deliver a repeat performance in order to reignite its faltering stock.

Prabowo’s Own Brother Sounds Alarm Over Indonesian Stock Market
top_signals.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto’s brother stressed the importance of a trusted and transparent local share market, saying the country must “mitigate the MSCI issue” and telling business leaders at a forum Thursday to stop “deep frying” stocks.

top_signals.title: Subsea Vessel Market: Shifting Dynamics + Fleet Expansion
top_signals.summary: We are entering in interesting period in the subsea vessel market, as contract backlog among the EPCs continue to rise to new all-time highs, existing long-term contracts are coming up for renewals, and a wave of newbuilds are closing in on delivery.
